exercises.title: U1 听力·对话 Choosing a Funny Film
exercises.speaker: uk_female
transcript: Anna: Have you seen any good comedies lately?
Ben: Yes! I watched 'My Crazy Family' at the weekend. I laughed my head off.
Anna: Really? Was it that funny?
Ben: It was. There is one scene where the dad falls into a huge cake. I almost cried with laughter.
Anna: It sounds great. Who is in it?
Ben: A famous comedian called Tom Lee. His timing is perfect.
Anna: Then I must watch it tonight. Thanks for the tip!
Ben: Enjoy it. Just don't drink anything while you watch, or you'll spill it laughing!
exercises.translation_cn: Anna 问 Ben 最近有没有看好喜剧;Ben 周末看了《我的疯狂家庭》,笑得不行;有一幕爸爸掉进大蛋糕,他差点笑哭;主演是著名笑星 Tom Lee,节奏感极好;Anna 决定今晚就看;Ben 提醒她看时别喝东西,以免笑着洒出来。

exercises.title: U1 听力·短文 What Clown Doctors Do
exercises.speaker: uk_female
transcript: Clown doctors are specially trained performers who work in hospitals.
They wear bright wigs and big red noses to make sick children smile.
On a normal day, they tell jokes, sing songs and do magic tricks.
They always work together with the real doctors and nurses.
Their goal is simple: to make a frightening place feel a little friendlier.
exercises.translation_cn: 小丑医生是受过专门训练、在医院工作的表演者;他们戴鲜艳假发和大红鼻子逗患病儿童笑;平常会讲笑话、唱歌、变魔术;总是和真正的医生护士一起工作;目标很简单:让令人害怕的地方变得友善一点。

exercises.title: U1 听力·对话 An April Fool's Trick
exercises.speaker: uk_female
transcript: Cara: Did anyone trick you on April Fool's Day?
Dan: Yes! My brother told me that school was closed for the whole day.
Cara: And did you believe him?
Dan: I did at first. I was so happy that I went straight back to bed!
Cara: Oh no. What happened then?
Dan: Mum came in and asked why I wasn't ready. I had to run all the way to school.
Cara: That's a classic trick. Were you late?
Dan: Just by five minutes. My brother couldn't stop laughing all evening.
exercises.translation_cn: Cara 问 Dan 愚人节有没有被骗;Dan 说哥哥骗他学校全天停课;他起初信了,高兴地回去睡觉;妈妈进来问他为何没准备,他只好一路跑去学校;只迟到五分钟;哥哥一整晚都笑个不停。

questions.stem: What did Dan's brother tell him?
options: That school was closed for the day.
That it was going to snow.
That he had won a prize.

questions.stem: Did Dan believe the trick at first?

options: He was late for a film.

questions.stem: How did Dan's brother feel that evening?
options: He kept laughing about the trick.

exercises.title: U1 听力·短文 Mark Twain at the Barber's
exercises.speaker: uk_female
transcript: Mark Twain was famous for his quick wit.
One day he went into a barber's shop for a shave.
The barber, who did not know him, asked if he had a ticket for Twain's lecture that night.
Twain said that he did not.
'Then you'll have to stand,' said the barber, 'every seat has been sold.'
'That's just my luck,' Twain replied. 'I always have to stand when that man lectures.'
exercises.translation_cn: 马克·吐温以机智著称;一天他去理发店刮胡子;不认识他的理发师问他有没有当晚吐温讲座的票;吐温说没有;理发师说那你只能站着,座位都卖光了;吐温回道:'真倒霉,那家伙演讲时我总得站着。'

questions.stem: Why did Twain go into the shop?

options: No, he did not know him.

questions.stem: What did the barber ask Twain about?
What did the barber say about the seats?
Why is Twain's reply funny?
options: He joked as if he were not the lecturer himself.
He could not afford a seat.

exercises.title: U1 听力·对话 Planning a Comedy Act
exercises.speaker: uk_female
transcript: Eva: We need to plan our comedy act for the school show. Any ideas?
Sam: How about telling funny stories about our first day at school?
Eva: I like that. Everyone can understand it.
Sam: We should also add a surprise ending to each story.
Eva: Good. And let's practise our timing, so the jokes land well.
Sam: Agreed. Maybe I can use a few simple props, like a giant pair of glasses.
Eva: Perfect. If we make the audience laugh in the first minute, the rest will be easy.
Sam: Then let's start writing the script tonight.
exercises.translation_cn: Eva 和 Sam 商量校园演出的喜剧节目;Sam 提议讲开学第一天的趣事,大家都能懂;还要给每个故事加个出人意料的结尾;Eva 说要练好节奏让笑点到位;Sam 想用些简单道具,比如一副巨大的眼镜;Eva 说只要头一分钟逗笑观众,后面就轻松了;两人决定今晚开始写脚本。

exercises.title: U1 听力·短文 A Tip for a Happier Life
exercises.speaker: uk_female
transcript: Here is a simple tip for a happier life: try to laugh every day.
Scientists say that laughter helps the body make chemicals that lower stress.
It also brings people closer together.
You do not need an expensive ticket or a famous comedian.
A silly joke with a friend is often enough.
So next time you feel worried, share a laugh; it really is one of the best kinds of medicine.
exercises.translation_cn: 一个让生活更快乐的小贴士:每天都笑一笑;科学家说笑能帮身体产生降低压力的化学物质;它还能拉近人与人的距离;你不需要昂贵的票或著名笑星;和朋友说个傻笑话往往就够了;所以下次烦恼时,一起笑一笑吧,它真是最好的良药之一。
